Winter work

From November to March the committee mends the fences, cuts the hedges and clears the ditches along the lane. Members who can spare a morning are welcome, and tea is made in the hut at eleven. The list of jobs for the month is on the board by the gate, with the name of the member who looks after each one.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. The water supply is off until April.
